{{Youmay|the map-making profession|[[Cartographer (disambiguation)|other uses of the word]]}}
A '''cartographer''' referred to one who produced maps, particularly of an [[Astrography|astrographical]] nature. [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] cartographers were responsible for establishing the sprawling [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
